summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Wetnose Veterinary Clinic admin panel. Backend APIs: 14/16 tests passed (87.5%). Frontend UI: All admin pages working correctly including Login, Dashboard, Settings, Services, Team, Gallery, and Roles. Settings save functionality verified working.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'Albüm bulunamadı' - Next.js routing conflict with [albumId] dynamic route. The static 'albums' folder is being caught by the dynamic route.
Services are soft-deleted (archived) not hard-deleted, so GET returns 200 after DELETE. This is expected behavior, not a bug.
